summary: Ollama is a local LLM runtime whose core platform is a native REST API (/api/generate, /api/chat with NDJSON streaming, errors and usage fields), a Modelfile build format (FROM, PARAMETER, TEMPLATE, SYSTEM, ADAPTER), a Docker-v2-style registry with content-addressed blobs and manifests, GGUF/safetensors import and quantization tags, LoRA adapters, OpenAI and Anthropic compatible endpoints, and a think capability. Compiled from 44 source files (cached /dr page bodies, /dr claim units and the docs.ollama.com mirror) across 20 hosts.

Ollama manifests reuse the Docker image manifest v2 schema 2 envelope (schemaVersion 2, mediaType, a config object and a layers array whose entries carry mediaType, size and sha256 digest); Ollama substitutes its own layer media types (model, template, license, params) for image layers.

The models directory holds blobs/ with content-addressed files named by digest with ':' replaced by '-' (sha256-<64 hex>), and manifests/ with per-tag JSON, e.g. manifests/registry.ollama.ai/library/gemma3/270m. Blobs are shared by digest, so tags with the same weights layer share one file.

Ollama's OpenAI layer implements /v1/chat/completions, /v1/completions, /v1/models, /v1/embeddings and /v1/responses. Chat supports streaming, JSON mode, seed, tools, base64 vision and reasoning control; logprobs are unsupported. Embeddings reject token-array input.

Compressing a model is like compressing an image, but the loss is not distributed uniformly: some layers tolerate 4 bits, others do not. That is exactly what K and IQ quantizations exploit by allocating more bits to sensitive tensors.

Standard quantization maps all weights to lower precision uniformly, which can degrade quality on the layers that matter most. The imatrix (importance matrix) path addresses this by using calibration data to identify which weights have the highest activation impact, then allocating more precision to those weights during quantization.

The proposed fix, #17537 ("server: verify blob digest before trusting a same-size cache hit"), makes both pull paths hash a candidate blob before trusting it.
